title: A small museum of forms
description: A fictional exhibit demonstrating a portable guided 3D template.

items.title: The sphere
items.description: A continuous surface generated from latitude and longitude. This fictional exhibit introduces the geometry of a rounded form.

items.title: The torus
items.description: A ring generated from two circular parameters. Its repeating topology creates a surface with a central opening.

items.title: The cylinder
items.description: A circular wall capped at both ends. A simple procedural building block for tools, architecture, and exhibits.
